info.title: ClrKernel — multi-language .NET notebook tool.
info.description: Multi-language .NET notebook CLI. One tool, three modes: `clrkernel jupyter` (Jupyter kernel), `clrkernel serve` (stdio JSON-RPC server for the VS Code extension), and `clrkernel run` (headless .nb.md/.dib/.ipynb runner with papermill-style parameters). C# cells evaluated with Roslyn scripting. Fork of SciSharp/ICSharpCore.

commands.name: lsp
commands.description:
Run the unified language server (LSP
completion/hover/signature help + execution).

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Execute a .nb.md/.dib/.ipynb/.csx notebook
headlessly, with papermill-style parameters.

options.name: --parameters_file
options.description: Load parameters from a YAML or JSON file.

options.name: --parameters_yaml
options.description: Load parameters from an inline YAML/JSON string.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write an executed .ipynb notebook to PATH
(cells with their captured outputs).

options.name: --cwd
options.description:
Working directory for the run
(defaults to the notebook's directory).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
-p, --parameters NAME VALUE    Set a parameter, type-inferred
-r, --parameters_raw NAME VALUE

commands.name: serve
commands.description:
Run the stdio JSON-RPC notebook server
